en: I am interested in how emotional stimuli and experiences orchestrate the brain and body.

I have a background in biomedical engineering, with training in AI-based computational approaches to theoretical and clinical neuroscience. I am now interested in the foundations of affective psychophysiology and neuroscience.
I am learning the processes involved in collecting, preprocessing, and analyzing EEG and MRI data, as well as exploring innovative applications of artificial intelligence in this field.
ko: 저는 emotional stimuli와 experiences가 brain과 body의 작용을 어떻게 조율하는지에 대해서 연구하고 있습니다.
Biomedical Engineering에서는 theoretical and clinical neuroscience에 적용되는 AI-based computational approaches를 훈련받았습니다. 현재는 affective psychophysiology와 neuroscience의 기초를 탐구하고 있습니다.
현재 EEG와 MRI 데이터의 data collection, preprocessing 및 analysis 과정을 배우고 있으며, 이 분야에서 artificial intelligence를 활용하는 새로운 방법도 탐색하고 있습니다.
